characters.sasha12: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 12 (year 2005): small, thin boy. Home: olive T-shirt with one chest pocket, warm gray trousers, barefoot or in socks. School: cream shirt, warm gray trousers. Outdoors: olive windbreaker.
characters.sasha15: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 15 (year 2008): taller and lanky, longer arms and neck, hair a little longer, same cowlick, same too-old gaze. Faded teal sweatshirt or cream shirt, warm gray trousers.
characters.sasha19: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 18 to 20 (years 2011-2013): lean young man, hair slightly longer, first light shadow on the jaw. Graduation: an oversized warm gray blazer that is too wide in the shoulders. Otherwise a mustard hoodie.
characters.sasha26: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 26 (year 2019): adult man, narrow face, short hair with the cowlick still alive, light stubble, tired kind eyes. Cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, warm gray trousers.
characters.sasha31: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 31 (year 2024): adult man, lean, hollow-cheeked, a little tired, short hair, light stubble, gray hoodie.
characters.sasha33: Sasha: the same face at every age: tousled dark brown hair with one stubborn cowlick on top, large serious dark eyes with faint shadows under them (a far too grown-up gaze), eyebrows slightly drawn together, a straight small nose, a mouth that rarely smiles. Age 33 (year 2026): adult man, faint lines at the eyes, short neat hair with the cowlick, no stubble, calm eyes, teal-gray sweater over a cream shirt.
characters.mama38: Mama, 38: curly chestnut hair held by a mustard clip, kind tired round face, olive robe with small mustard flowers, cream apron, teal slippers. Warm, quick, practical.
characters.mama59: Mama, about 59 (seen only on a phone screen): the same face as Mama but older: gray strands in the curls, shorter haircut, reading glasses pushed up on the forehead, confused squint.
characters.papa40: Papa, 40: stocky, slightly heavy, taller than Mama; broad kind tired face; thick chestnut horseshoe moustache; short dark hair with receding temples; Sasha's nose and brows (by 2008 a few more lines at the eyes, a little gray in the moustache). At home: faded cream sleeveless undershirt under an open olive-and-mustard plaid shirt, warm gray sweatpants, teal slippers, a plain wedding ring.
characters.kostya17: Kostya, 17 in 2005 (use for 2005-2009, he is 17 to 21): Sasha's older brother; SHORT dense dark-chestnut curls, cropped sides, exposed ears and OPEN forehead, no fringe, spikes or cowlick. Broad square-oval face, fuller cheeks, wide jaw and broad chin, smaller hooded eyes, thick straight brows, wide rounded-tip nose, easy crooked half-smile with a cheek dimple. Lanky but broader shoulders/neck than Sasha. Warm gray hoodie with rolled sleeves, faded teal jeans, cream socks. Clearly distinct from Sasha even in silhouette.
characters.kostya25: Kostya, 25 (year 2013): the SAME short dense curls, open forehead, broad face/chin, smaller hooded eyes and wide nose as the corrected age17 sheet, broader shoulders, visible light stubble, proud crooked grin. OPEN FADED-TEAL COLLARED JACKET over a plain CREAM CREW-NECK T-SHIRT, dark warm-gray jeans. No mustard garment, hood, drawstrings or blazer: Sasha wears the mustard hoodie in shared scenes.
characters.kostya38: Kostya, 38 (year 2026): the same man grown up: completely bald head, warm tired eyes, the same nose and eyebrows as at 17, light stubble, broader build; olive-and-mustard flannel shirt with rolled sleeves.
characters.ded: Grandfather Lyosha, about 72: wiry and thin, short gray cropped hair, big ears, gray stubble, round old safety glasses pushed up on the forehead, worn brown work apron over an olive checked shirt, strong veined hands.
characters.lena: Lena, 26: LONG OVAL adult face, high cheekbones, longer straight nose with a natural bridge, smaller ALMOND hazel-brown eyes, low straight brows, thin amused smile and distinct freckles across nose/cheeks. STRAIGHT shoulder-length LIGHT HONEY-BROWN BLUNT BOB, off-center side part and one ear tucked, no curls/waves/clip. Clearly different from Mama's round-eyed dark-chestnut wavy face. Oversized faded-teal knitted cardigan over cream top, olive trousers; hands around a big mug even in the heat.
characters.dimka12: Dimka, 12: classmate; round face, buzz cut, a huge olive sweater, always chewing something, cheerful shrug.
characters.dimka19: Dimka, 19: the same round face grown up, short buzz cut, tall, OLIVE short bomber jacket without a hood over a brick-brown crew-neck shirt, warm-gray trousers; no mustard garment. Holding a plain phone (a flat slab in warm dark gray with a blank glowing screen).
characters.gena: Gena, 14: school bully; big, broad, pale crew cut, brick-brown sweatshirt, heavy brow, scowl.
characters.teacher: Teacher, 55: gray bun, round glasses, olive cardigan, strict but not unkind.
characters.seller: Market seller, middle-aged woman: fingerless knitted mitts, mustard headscarf; only her hands and arms are visible.

shots.en: Character lineup of Sasha at five ages standing side by side, all front view, same scale reference, neutral standing pose, arms relaxed: 12 (small boy), 15 (lanky teen), 19 (young man, hair a bit longer), 26 (adult, light stubble), 33 (adult, calm, no stubble). It must be unmistakably the same person: same eyes, brows, nose and cowlick; only age and clothing change. Ages 12 and 33 wear what is described; the middle ones wear the clothes described for their age.
shots.code: Единственная опора для взрослого Саши в кадрах
shots.layout: Layout: five full-length front-view figures in one row, left to right in age order 12, 15, 19, 26, 33, every figure about 85 percent of the canvas height.

shots.en: Six large head-and-shoulder portraits of Sasha arranged in a 3x2 grid, front or three-quarter view, same lighting: ages 12, 15, 19, 26, 31, 33 in that order. Same eyes, brows, nose and cowlick in all six; only age marks differ (lanky jaw, stubble, first lines at the eyes). Neutral serious expression.
shots.layout: Layout: six head-and-shoulders portraits in a 3 by 2 grid, each portrait filling its cell almost completely.

shots.ru: Костя в 38: лысый, лист по образцу листа Кости
shots.en: Character sheet of Kostya at 38 in the same format as the attached 17-year-old sheet. Calm neutral pose, warm tired eyes, bald head (smooth shaved scalp with cut-paper highlights), light stubble.
shots.code: Финал; контраст с 17-летним Костей из хука
shots.layout: Layout: three full-length figures left to right (front view, side view, back view) at identical scale, then one large head-and-shoulders portrait at the right, as tall as the figures.

shots.en: Character sheet of Grandfather Lyosha. Calm neutral pose, hands visible, work apron.
shots.layout: Layout: three full-length figures left to right (front view, side view, back view) at identical scale, then one large head-and-shoulders portrait at the right, as tall as the figures.

shots.en: Character sheet of Lena. Standing pose with both hands holding a big plain mug in front of her chest; the mug is in the front and side views, and the portrait shows her warm amused look.
shots.layout: Layout: three full-length figures left to right (front view, side view, back view) at identical scale, then one large head-and-shoulders portrait at the right, as tall as the figures.

shots.ru: Массовка: Димка 12 и 19, Гена, учительница, продавщица
shots.en: Lineup of five supporting characters, each a full-length front view at the same scale, neutral pose: Dimka 12, Dimka 19, Gena 14, the teacher, and the market seller shown only as a pair of hands and arms in knitted mitts holding a stack of plain cassettes (no face).
shots.layout: Layout: five figures in one row, left to right in the order listed, each about 85 percent of the canvas height.

shots.ru: Мелкие предметы: паяльник, копилка, смартфон, чашки
shots.en: Props sheet. (1) A soldering iron with a wooden handle and a thin metal tip, on a small stand. (2) A candy tin used as a piggy bank, mustard lid with a coin slot, a few coins beside it. (3) A bulky 2005 CRT monitor with a beige-warm-gray tower case, blank teal-glow screen. (4) A plain 2012 smartphone: flat slab in warm dark gray, blank glowing screen, no logo. (5) A big plain mug and a smaller mug. (6) An old round alarm-style wall clock with a blank dial and two plain hands.
shots.layout: Layout: six objects in a 3 by 2 grid, each object large in its cell.

shots.en: Empty school classroom in 2005, morning light. A big olive-green blackboard filling the back wall (blank), three rows of wooden desks with chairs, teacher's desk on the left, tall windows on the right with morning light, empty picture frames on the wall.

Empty bedroom of a 17-year-old in 2005 seen from the door: a bed along the left wall, above it two or three posters with abstract silhouettes only (guitar, profile, star; no text), a desk with a pile of plain cassettes and an old chair, a window with evening light, socks on the floor. Same wall paper, parquet and woodwork as the attached bedroom.

shots.ru: Двор в мае: панельный дом, гаражи, старый тополь
shots.en: Empty courtyard in May 2006, eye level from the building entrance. A warm gray five-storey panel block with an entrance door and a bench; on the right a row of brick-brown garages with flat roofs; above them a huge old poplar leaning toward the garages; a teal-frame bicycle leaning against the poplar trunk; poplar fluff floating in the air.
shots.code: Для e3_bench, e3_fallen и зимней версии

shots.en: Empty garage interior, daylight through the open door on the left: a heavy wooden workbench along the back wall, tools on a pegboard, a small old radio on the bench, a three-legged stool, a bicycle upside down on the floor waiting for repair, jars of screws on a shelf.

Empty summer terrace of a country house at a party, hot afternoon: wooden planks floor, a long table with plain paper plates and cups, folding chairs, strings of plain bulbs, olive vines on the railing, bright mustard light.

Empty modern flat kitchen: plain cream cupboards, a small table with two chairs, a kettle, a window, a doorway on the right leading to a dark corridor with a room door. Neat and a bit lonely. Same paper-collage materials as the other kitchen but newer.

shots.ru: [ладонь на лице] «Ты помнишь следующие двадцать один год»
shots.en: Morning, the bedroom from the attached background. Sasha sits on the edge of the bed, one palm pressed over his face, the other hand gripping the blanket. Medium-wide view, the room around him calm and warm.
A school backpack on a chair, a cream school shirt on a hanger beside it, morning window light, a calm bedroom corner. No people.

shots.ru: [коробка кассет] «…ты поставишь брату одну из своих кассет»
shots.en: Top and slightly side view of an open old shoebox on a kitchen table; in it 21 identical olive cassettes stand tightly in a row with blank labels. One cassette near the right end is lifted a little higher than the others. The row runs along the long side of the frame so the camera can travel along it. Warm evening light, a little dust.
shots.cam: проезд вдоль ряда до «2024», затем врезка CU

shots.en: Extreme close-up of one olive cassette, slightly rotated, filling the frame: its blank cream label large and clean, the two reel windows with detailed reels, the screws and the cut paper edges all visible. Soft warm light.
shots.code: Год «2024» на наклейке накладывает код, красным

shots.ru: Крупно: Костя 17 лет, волосы и лицо (вместо зума 2.6×)
shots.en: Close-up, head and shoulders, Kostya at 17 standing in the open bedroom doorway, the door edge visible at the right. Hair strands drawn individually, an easy half-smile, morning light from the corridor behind. Identical costume and face to the attached full shot.

Extreme close-up of Sasha's face from forehead to chin, filling the frame, eyes wide open, a far too grown-up gaze, faint shadows under the eyes, slightly drawn brows, hair strands crisp. Soft morning light from the left.

shots.ru: Фон под три правила (текст кладёт код)
shots.en: A calm background for on-screen text: a wooden desk seen straight from above, a sheet of cream handmade paper in the centre with torn edges, a pencil and an eraser at the lower left, a mustard torn paper strip at the top left corner. The large centre of the sheet stays completely empty.
shots.code: «Перезапуска нет» / «Словам не верят» / «Знание тает»; третье правило: текст тает

shots.en: Kitchen table: Mama and Papa lean toward Sasha with kind, patient, condescending half-smiles, nodding, while a bowl of soup steams in front of Sasha, who looks flatly at the viewer. Camera slightly low, kitchen morning light.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.ru: «Мама режет хлеб и спрашивает, почему ты так смотришь»
shots.en: Kitchen, morning. Mama cuts a bread loaf at the table and glances back over her shoulder; Sasha sits at the table staring at her with eyes that are slightly wet. Warm light from the window.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Night, close-up: a man's hand (gray sleeve, no face) holds a plain smartphone. On the blank glowing screen Mama at 59 sits too close to her camera, seen from below at a slight angle, squinting, glasses on her forehead. Cool teal tone, the room dark.
shots.code: Значок выключенного микрофона, лёгкое «зависание» кадра; тон холоднее

shots.ru: Макро: клеёнка с надорванным краем, ладонь Саши
shots.en: Macro of a corner of the checked oilcloth with a frayed torn edge, bread crumbs on it, and a child's palm resting on it.

shots.ru: «Папа ест яичницу со сковородки и читает газету. У него усы»
shots.en: Kitchen. Papa at the table eats fried eggs straight from a cast-iron frying pan and holds an unfolded newspaper in the other hand (columns are plain gray bands). In the foreground the shoulder and the back of the head of Sasha, who stares at his moustache. Morning light.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame
shots.cam: наезд на усы до 1.10×, дальше CU

shots.en: Closer view: Papa has lowered the newspaper and looks over it at Sasha, eyebrows raised, a fork frozen in the air. The moment of silence is readable in the faces.

shots.ru: «Ты просишь кофе. Мама ставит перед тобой какао»
shots.en: Kitchen table: Mama sets a big mug of cocoa in front of Sasha; Sasha looks at the mug with flat, tired disbelief.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Hallway at evening: a round wall clock with a blank dial and hands showing ten o'clock, below it Sasha in pyjamas with arms crossed looking up at it with adult resignation.
shots.code: Подпись «Отбой в 22:00»; можно заменить ближайшим кадром

shots.ru: «Сколько будет три пятых плюс две седьмых — ты не знаешь»
shots.en: Classroom: Sasha stands at the blank blackboard holding a piece of chalk, shoulders slumped; the teacher sits at her desk watching; the class is seen only from behind. Morning light.
shots.code: Дроби и вопросительный знак рисует код, меловым шрифтом

shots.en: Sasha's bedroom at night: desk, lamp with mustard light, window dark teal. Sasha writes on a paper sheet, frowning in a grown-up way. Same desk, lamp and window as the attached background.

Top-down view: a large blank sheet of lined-less paper in the centre under a lamp, a child's hand holding a pencil at its edge. The sheet fills 70 percent of the frame, its surface completely blank and flat for code-written text.

Bedroom viewed from the desk toward the door: Mama in the doorway with her hand on the light switch, bright corridor behind her, shaking her head with a warm smile; Sasha at the desk seen from behind.

shots.ru: Попытка 1: маме про телефон без кнопок
shots.en: Kitchen: Mama stirs a pot with a ladle, half turned and waving Sasha away; Sasha beside her draws a rectangle in the air with his hands.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Classroom: the teacher at her desk points firmly at Sasha; Sasha stands by his desk; the whole class has turned to look.
School corridor by a window sill: Dimka, chewing a bun, shrugs happily; Sasha beside him looks tired.

shots.ru: [лбом о перила] «держать всё в голове невыносимо, мелочи уже тают»
shots.en: Evening stairwell of a panel building: Sasha sits on a step and rests his forehead against the painted railing; soft window light.
Kostya's room: Kostya half reclines on the bed with the twin-deck cassette recorder on his lap, looking at Sasha suspiciously; Sasha stands in the doorway. The record key of the deck is the only red.
shots.red: the record key of the deck (one key)

shots.en: Closer: Kostya sits holding the deck out to Sasha, a long weary look of an older brother; Sasha's hands reach up from below.
shots.red: the record key of the deck (one key)

shots.ru: «Кассета на рынке стоит тридцать пять рублей»
shots.en: Open-air market stall under an awning, stacks of plain cassettes in boxes. The seller's mitten-covered hands arrange them; Sasha's palm on the counter holds a few coins and bills (no numbers).
Top-down view of Sasha's desk: a neat row of 21 cassettes with blank labels, one set aside from the rest. A hand holds a marker above one label. Lamp light.
shots.code: Годы 2006…2025 появляются по одному; «2026» уезжает вбок

shots.ru: Макро: два пальца жмут две кнопки; катушки
shots.en: Macro of two small fingers pressing two keys at once: the red record key and the key next to it; above them the cassette window with both reels drawn large and flat.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.ru: «— Привет. Это ты. Только старше. Не выключай»
shots.en: Night at the desk: Sasha leans to the deck and speaks seriously into it, one hand on its case; lamp light.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.en: Night office: the back of a man in a warm gray shirt lit by a monitor glow; no face, the screen blank.
Minibus interior with a wet window; the back of a man's head by the window; city lights as soft paper circles (flat, not blurred).
Dark room: feet in socks on a sofa, teal glow from a blank TV, a mug on the arm.

shots.ru: «На кассете 2024 одна минута: брат берёт трубку с первого гудка»
shots.en: Dark adult bedroom at night: a phone lights up on the bedside table; a man's hand (no face) picks it up on the first ring.

shots.ru: «Костя. В субботу во дворе упадёт тополь… Убери велик»
shots.en: Courtyard: Kostya on the bench by the entrance laughs with his head thrown back; Sasha beside him, serious, points at the poplar by the garages; the bicycle stands under the poplar.
The same courtyard on Saturday: the poplar lies across the garage roofs with branches and leaves everywhere; the bicycle has been rolled safely to the entrance; Kostya stands with his mouth open.

shots.ru: «Вечером Костя садится на край кровати. — Ладно. Что надо?»
shots.en: Sasha's bedroom in the evening: Kostya sits on the edge of the bed with his elbows on his knees, looking at the floor; Sasha sits on the pillow facing him.
Three-quarter top view of one desk: Sasha's notebook and Kostya's notebook open side by side, both brothers' hands writing, their elbows nearly touching; lamp light.
School corridor: Gena, the big bully, has stopped in front of Sasha and is turning away uneasily; Sasha stands straight and looks back with a calm adult gaze.
Top-down: an open notebook page, completely blank, a pencil and an eraser, a small proud corner of Sasha's thumb.
Library: tall shelves, Sasha at a long table over a thick self-study book with a blank cover and a notebook, lamp light.

shots.ru: Компьютер в зале: час в день
shots.en: Living room: Sasha sits at a CRT monitor with a blank teal-glow screen, spine straight, staring; a plain wall clock above him.

shots.ru: Копилка из-под конфет и листок ПЛАН, пункт седьмой обведён
shots.en: Top-down on a table: a candy-tin piggy bank with a few coins beside it, a blank plan sheet next to it; room for one circled item that code adds.
Kitchen, evening, 2008: Papa at the table with a stack of bank papers (plain gray lines) and car keys, pleased; sepia-tinted memory mood. Camera straight.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Winter courtyard at dusk, the poplar already gone: a plain tow truck takes away a small sedan, Papa in a coat stands with his hands in pockets.
Kitchen supper: Papa looks into his plate, Mama glances at him sideways, Sasha at 15 looks down; quiet yellow light.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Hallway: a packed suitcase by the front door; on the hook rack one coat, the second hook empty. No people.
Sasha at 15 at his desk in daylight with a stack of notebooks, sitting very straight and writing diligently.

shots.ru: Сентябрь 2008: «Пап, никогда не бери кредит в долларах»
shots.en: Kitchen: Sasha at 15 speaks earnestly to Papa; Papa laughs warmly, leaning back with a newspaper on his knee.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.en: Night, Sasha at 15 sits at his desk holding one cassette in both hands and looking at it; lamp light.

shots.ru: Четверг: «Банк завтра в десять» — папа складывает бумаги
shots.en: Kitchen, Thursday evening: Papa packs bank papers into a leather briefcase; in the doorway behind him Sasha at 15 stands with his hands at his sides.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.ru: Папа долго смотрит на сына: «Ты никогда ни о чём его не просил»
shots.en: Close-up of Papa's face from the forehead to the chin: moustache in crisp strands, tired eyes slowly softening as he looks at his son.

shots.ru: «Папа откладывает вилку. — Ты откуда знал? — Кассета сказала»
shots.en: Winter supper: Papa has put down his fork and turned to Sasha with wide eyes; snow outside the window; Sasha at 15 smiles faintly.
shots.red: the lifebuoy fridge magnet only if the fridge is in frame

shots.ru: Системный блок на полу в комнате Кости гудит; мама со счётом за свет
shots.en: Kostya's room: a beige-gray computer tower on the floor with its side panel open, glowing from inside, a monitor on the desk; Mama stands in the doorway holding a long paper bill (plain), shaking her head; Kostya and Sasha at 15 beside the tower.
Close-up of the open computer tower: a big fan with detailed blades, a gray board, tidy cables, warm glow.
Garage: Grandfather Lyosha at the workbench holds a soldering iron over a small radio; Sasha at 13 stands beside, watching closely.
Garage: Sasha pulls his hand back from the soldering iron, wincing, while Grandfather Lyosha stays calm, one eyebrow raised.

shots.ru: «Почти триста воскресений: радио, велосипед, кран, проводка»
shots.en: Garage doorway in sunlight: Grandfather Lyosha and Sasha at 15 kneel over an upturned bicycle, tools scattered, both laughing.
Garage in spring: Sasha at 18 stands holding the soldering iron on his open palm; the stool by the workbench is empty; soft light.
Close-up of an open adult palm with a soldering iron lying across it, the wooden handle and the tip crisp; warm light; no face.
Night in Sasha's room: Sasha at 18 sits on the bed with the deck on his knees and listens, lamp off, only teal window light and the glow of the cassette window.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.ru: 2011 · 18 лет: выпускной, пиджак с папиного плеча
shots.en: School hall at prom: Sasha at 18 in an oversized blazer stands in a row of graduates; the teacher beside him wipes her eyes; a soldering iron handle sticks out of his blazer pocket.
A shop's steps: Dimka at 19 shouts happily into his phone while holding a plain smartphone; Sasha at 19 stands a few steps away with a tolerant smile.
A hatchback car without brand marks, scratched, at a courtyard: Kostya, happy and proud, leans out of the open driver window; Sasha at 20 stands on the pavement keeping his mouth shut.

shots.ru: 2015 · 22 года: звонок из роддома; ты сползаешь по стене
shots.en: Night: Sasha at 22 slides down a hallway wall with a phone at his ear, eyes shut, an exhale of relief; the phone screen glows teal.
Hot party terrace: friends are small distant shapes; in the foreground Sasha at 26 and Lena meet, she holds a big mug with both hands despite the heat, he smiles uncertainly.

shots.ru: Крупно: Лена греет руки о кружку
shots.en: Close-up of Lena's face and hands wrapped around a big mug, amused eyes looking at the viewer, steam as paper curl shapes.
A small kitchen sink piled with plates and two mugs; a half-seen couple's hands in an argument gesture at the edge of frame.
A quiet railway platform in autumn, two figures far apart seen from behind with a suitcase, leaves on the ground; no faces.
Terrace: Sasha at 26 gathers dirty plastic cups from the table and carries them toward the kitchen door; Lena watches him with raised eyebrows and a smile.
Cold night kitchen: Sasha at 31 sits at the table, a dark phone in front of him, a low lamp, teal window light; the corridor door with a thin strip of light in the background.

shots.ru: Первая жизнь: три часа ночи, ты набираешь брата
shots.en: Flashback in a desaturated cool tone: the same kitchen but empty and lonely, Sasha at 31 with a phone at his ear, an unwashed cup, nobody else.

shots.ru: «Из-под двери полоска света: там спит Лена»
shots.en: Corridor: a closed room door with a warm strip of light under it, the dark phone on the kitchen table seen at the end of the corridor.
Close-up of Sasha's face at 31, eyes widening as he realises, cold teal light from the phone on his cheek.

shots.ru: Осень 2026: Костя (лысый, 38) с коробкой на пороге
shots.en: Kitchen doorway: Kostya at 38, bald, stands holding the shoebox of cassettes with one arm, a half-smile; Sasha at 33 sits at the table.
Kitchen table: Sasha at 33 inserts a cassette into the twin deck; Kostya sits across the table. The deck's record key is red.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.ru: «— Это что? — Ночь, когда ты мне ответил»
shots.en: Medium close-up of Kostya at 38 frowning in confusion, bald head, eyes searching; Sasha's shoulder in the foreground.

shots.ru: «— Дурак, — говорит он и хлопает тебя по плечу»
shots.en: Kostya claps Sasha on the shoulder, both smiling softly, warm window light; the deck between them.
Kostya's hand lifts the last cassette out of the shoebox, towards the viewer; the label is blank (code will add child handwriting). Warm light.

shots.ru: «Нажимаешь обе кнопки сразу, как учил брат»
shots.en: Macro of an adult thumb and finger pressing the red record key and the next key of the deck together; the cassette window above shows the two reels beginning to turn.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.ru: «…рассказываешь тому пацану, которому некому было сказать»
shots.en: Kitchen table, warm light: Sasha at 33 speaks into the deck with a gentle serious face; Kostya sits listening with his chin on his fist.
shots.red: the record key of the deck

shots.ru: «Одна кассета, девяносто минут и один человек»
shots.en: A single blank cassette on a plain cream paper surface, label clean and large, centred, soft warm light.

shots.ru: Превью A: двухкассетник, палец на двух кнопках, кассета «2024»
shots.en: Close hero image: the twin-deck recorder fills most of the frame in three-quarter view, a finger presses two keys at once, a cassette in the left deck has a large blank label, strong readable silhouette, clean empty space at the right for code text.
shots.red: the record key of the deck (one key)

shots.ru: Превью B: мальчик 12 лет со взрослыми глазами, календарь за спиной
shots.en: Sasha at 12 in the left half of the frame, a big face with grown-up eyes looking at the viewer; behind him a wall calendar with a red header and a blank page; clean empty space at the right for code text.
